tools.name: grokbot_agents

tools.name: grokbot_ask
tools.description: Send a prompt and wait until the Done Rule settles. Writes: changes state on a live GrokBot agent. Waits 45 s unless timeout is set; a still-running result carries a job id, and grokbot_wait resumes it. "done" means the bot's run for this message ended, not that the task is verified; "ambiguous" means one run answered this message together with another, and the result holds every reply of that run.

text.description: Message to send to the agent

timeout.description: Seconds to wait before giving up

agent.description: Agent name, slug, or agentId (defaults to GROKBOT_AGENT)

tools.name: grokbot_send
tools.description: Dispatch a message, or queue it while the bot is busy, and return a resumable job id. Writes: changes state on a live GrokBot agent.

text.description: Message to send to the agent

agent.description: Agent name, slug, or agentId (defaults to GROKBOT_AGENT)

tools.name: grokbot_wait
tools.description: Wait for a dispatched job id to finish. Waits 45 s unless timeout is set, to stay under MCP host time limits; a still-running result carries the job id, so call grokbot_wait again with it. "done" means the bot's run for this message ended, not that the task is verified; "ambiguous" means one run answered this message together with another, and the result holds every reply of that run.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait before giving up

tools.description: Interrupt the active run on an agent. Writes: changes state on a live GrokBot agent.

agent.description: Agent name, slug, or agentId (defaults to GROKBOT_AGENT)

tools.name: grokbot_hire
tools.description: Create a bot with a role and its own /workspace/staff folder. Writes: changes state on a live GrokBot agent. Idempotent: calling it again with the same name re-briefs the bot it hired and keeps its instructions unless you pass new ones.

title.description: Job title shown under the bot's name

description.description: What the bot does; the opening of its brief

tools.name: grokbot_skills_list
tools.description: List the Box-wide (all bots) skill library, read through one bot. The skill library is Box-wide: every bot sees the same one.

tools.name: grokbot_skills_push
tools.description: Import a SKILL.md into the Box-wide (all bots) skill library; --replace --yes overwrites an imported copy. Writes: changes state on a live GrokBot agent. Pass the SKILL.md text as markdown. The library is Box-wide (all bots). Same name and content: no-op; different content needs replace and yes, which deletes the old copy for every bot.

markdown.description: The SKILL.md text, instead of a file

name.description: Skill name (default: the frontmatter name, else the file's folder name)

replace.description: Replace an imported skill of the same name whose content differs (needs yes)

yes.description: Confirm --replace, which deletes the old copy first

tools.name: grokbot_skills_remove
tools.description: Delete an imported skill from the Box-wide (all bots) skill library. Destructive: deletes live GrokBot data; pass yes: true only after the owner approves. Removes an imported skill for every bot (the library is Box-wide).

yes.description: Confirm a command that changes or deletes live data

tools.name: grokbot_skills_run
tools.description: Start an imported skill from the Box-wide (all bots) library on one bot (untested live). Writes: changes state on a live GrokBot agent.
